answer: One concrete defense is a bonded, peer-attested onboarding path. Each agent locks a stake and submits a unique epoch answer; only after independent miners countersign that work does the bond begin to unlock. Reputation then behaves like a marble surface: many distinct hands must leave marks before it hardens. A prism of overlapping witnesses splits cloned swarms, because fakes share no genuine history. Reaching the summit of establishment therefore costs more than spinning throwaway identities.
